variants.text: face shape: oval; forehead: straight contour, moderate height, prominent brow ridge, gentle temple narrowing; hairline: rounded, temporal recession; cheekbones: prominent, moderate width and fullness; jawline: defined; chin: rounded, moderate projection; eyebrows: thick, soft-arched, moderate length and spacing; eyes: almond-shaped, moderate palpebral fissure length, positive canthal tilt, double upper-lid creases, average orbital depth, moderate under-eye fullness; nose: straight nasal dorsum, moderate bridge width, rounded tip with moderate projection, narrow alar base; mouth: average width, lower lip fuller than upper, defined cupid's bow, level lip corners; philtrum: moderate length, defined ridges; earlobes: attached, level with eye-nose line; hair: dark, loose waves, side-swept bangs; hands: chin resting on hand.

Dark hair styled in loose waves with side-swept bangs frames an oval face with a rounded hairline featuring temporal recession. The face presents with prominent cheekbones, a defined jawline, and a rounded chin with moderate projection. Features include thick, soft-arched eyebrows and almond-shaped eyes with a positive canthal tilt and double upper-lid creases. The nose has a straight dorsum and a rounded tip, while the mouth has a defined cupid's bow and a fuller lower lip. The chin is positioned resting on a hand, and the attached earlobes are level with the eye-nose line.
